name: Ferdinand Magellan
summary: Dedicated and results-driven DevOps Engineer with over 5 years of experience in building and maintaining environments for software applications. Proficient in automation, cloud technologies, and continuous deployment methodologies. Strong collaborative skills with a passion for enhancing productivity through effective process improvements.

description: Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
Managed cloud infrastructure on AWS and optimized costs through resource management.
Collaborated with development teams to ensure best practices in code quality and deployment processes.
Automated deployment processes using Docker and Kubernetes, reducing deployment time by 40%.
Implemented monitoring solutions with Prometheus and Grafana for system health checks.
Worked closely with QA teams to develop automated testing frameworks.
Maintained and improved server infrastructure for critical applications.
Configured and managed systems monitoring tools and alerts to ensure uptime.
Developed scripts for automation of routine tasks using Bash and Python.
